## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it is needed.

## User impact

Explain visible behavior changes, accessibility impact, and performance impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Light and dark themes checked
- [ ] Keyboard-only navigation checked
- [ ] Responsive layout checked where relevant

## Visual changes

Add screenshots or a short recording, or write "Not applicable."

## Third-party material

- [ ] No new third-party code or assets were added
- [ ] Any third-party material is identified with compatible license terms

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented
- [ ] No credentials or personal data are included
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes
